assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: a horizontally seamless repeating JUNGLE BACKGROUND for a 384x216 side-scrolling pixel shooter, matching the attached first-level design's upper jungle scene. The attachment is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, do not recreate its layout, HUD, characters, map strip, labels, rocks, bridge, or fortress. Generate a single wide landscape backdrop, 3:2 aspect ratio. True hard-edged 8-bit/16-bit pixel art with visibly chunky pixel clusters and restricted colors: saturated cobalt blue sky, distant jagged dark blue mountain ridges, black/teal jungle silhouettes and layered emerald palm fronds. Thin sky window across top 18 percent, mountain ridges top 15-40 percent, dense detailed overlapping tropical jungle filling the lower 75 percent all the way to bottom. Palms and tree ferns emerge on left and right, fine rich leaf detail but grouped into readable pixel clusters, bottom forest is very dark teal-black to separate player sprites. Full bleed environment only; NO terrain, NO walkable surfaces, NO ground, NO brown rocks, NO water, NO people, NO guns, NO enemies, NO fortress, NO UI, NO text. The left and right edges must join seamlessly when tiled horizontally, with same foliage height and matching colors at both edges. No light bloom, gradients, antialiasing, 3D, brushwork, photo textures or white gutters. This image will be scaled down with nearest-neighbor and repeated behind independently moving terrain. Pixel texture should remain attractive at 384px display size. Copy the lush foliage density, cobalt highlights, green palette and crisp pixel craft of the provided first-level design.
